mapper.select: select * from health_assessment where id_card = #{idCard} order by id for update
select * from check_in where id_card_no = #{idCard} and status = 0 for update

select f.id floor_id, f.name floor_name, r.id room_id, r.code room_code, b.id bed_id, b.bed_number from floor f join room r on r.floor_id = f.id join bed b on b.room_id = r.id where r.is_deleted = 0 and b.bed_status = #{status} order by f.code, f.id, r.sort, r.id, b.sort, b.id

select f.name floor_name, f.id floor_id, r.id room_id, r.code, rt.price from room r join floor f on f.id = r.floor_id join room_type rt on rt.name = r.type_name where r.id = #{id} and r.is_deleted = 0
